Plot a uniformity-trial analysis

Source: R/methods.R
plot.plotsizing_analysis.Rd

Draws one of the package figures from an analysis, using the settings stored in it (for example the marginal target slope).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'plotsizing_analysis'
plot(
  x,
  which = c("contours", "surface", "sections", "profiles", "heatmap"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object returned by analyze_uniformity_trial().

which

Figure to draw: "contours" (default, plot_cv_contours()), "surface" (plot_cv_surface()), "sections" (plot_curvature_sections()), "profiles" (plot_cv_profiles()) or "heatmap" (plot_trial_heatmap()).

...

Further arguments passed to the plotting function.

Value

A ggplot object, except for which = "surface", which draws a base-R plot and returns invisibly.

Examples

result <- analyze_uniformity_trial(example_trial("rice"), criterion = "all")
plot(result)

plot(result, which = "sections")
